path_rules: Compare Windows backslashes as forward slashes.
Normalize /mnt/c/... to C:/... and compare case-insensitively.
Export each known path under source_root_relative, preserving raw bytes and original SHA256.
Do not edit absolute paths inside authoritative JSON: that changes the bound receipt SHA256. A separately declared resolver/mount map is needed for local replay.
Same-SHA bytes at another public path are a relocation candidate, not evidence of missing content.

independent_final_execution.note: Original already-completed outputs are evidence and must not be overwritten. Supplying only a VERIFIED flag or leaf counts cannot satisfy input hashing/semantic gates.

independent_controls_execution.scope: These are mathematical arithmetic/retention replay arguments, not a new optimization/search and not formal geometric admission. No replay was run during this inventory audit.

suggested_server_minimum_export.operation: On the source server read both authoritative SHA ledgers, union by normalized original path, reject digest conflicts, compare public delivered SHA inventory and export missing bytes. Include seed records, manifests, receipt sides and frozen executors; do not regenerate searches or drop failed/unpaid history.
suggested_server_minimum_export.pack_rule: Chunk archives preserving bytes; produce original-path/relative-export-path/size/SHA256 manifest, and before/after source hashes. Absolute reference strings stay unchanged.

nested_frozen_geometry_schema.rule: Current files must already bind frozen copied files and all inherited sources; traverse references to diagnose absent paths, but never substitute receipt flags for omitted file bytes.

suggested_server_minimum_export.unknown_cross_roots_policy: All audited arithmetic dependencies lie under the recorded n-26 root. The unaudited formal files map may include additional original roots; detect them on the server and declare explicit namespace mappings instead of guessing or stripping arbitrary parent paths.

local_migration_search.scope: Known roots and shallow directory/index inspection only, not an exhaustive disk walk.
